summary: Stragent's first three-week dry run is legal. Gameweek 6 sells Scarlett for Muniz and captains Bruno Fernandes. Gameweek 7 sells Davis for Robinson and captains Haaland. Gameweek 8 holds. No chip, no hits, bank 15 then 6 then 1 tenth. The official ledger and the canonical plan file were not written.
